messages:
Sam W: Heads-up: I opened a new docs PR to rename our function-calling examples to action-invoke and add an envelope pattern. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/358
Priya K: Saw it. Good call on the envelope. Can we also add a short section on handling 'partial' responses and schema fallbacks?
Sam W: Yep, planning a paragraph + example handler. Draft envelope in the PR: 
```json
{
  "env_version": "2026-03-21",
  "status": "ok|partial|error",
  "action": {
    "id": "search_customer",
    "payload": { "customer_id": "string" }
  },
  "extras": {}
}
```
Marco L: Add an SDK snippet that shows unknown keys are ignored by default and how to opt-in to strict validation. Real production breakage is extra keys.
Jules R: Agreed. Also CI flagged a link to docs/old-function-guide.md — 404. link-checker: broken-link docs/old-function-guide.md
docs-bot: PR #358 CI: link-check failed (1 broken link)
Sam W: I'll remove the old file reference and include a migration note. Should we recommend renaming the runtime property `function` -> `action` everywhere?
Priya K: Recommend yes, but include a migration command folks can run: `rg "\bfunction\b" -S docs/ || echo "none"`. Put that in the migration guide.
Marco L: For the Node SDK example, show `client.invokeAction({ name, payload })` and the parsing flow: validate envelope -> validate payload JSON schema -> fallback if status != ok.
Sam W: Node example added, pinging @Jules for quick review.
Jules R: Quick notes: 1) Add a short Private-deploy note about cache key prefixes and TTL differences. 2) In the tests folder add a unit that passes envelope with extra fields and asserts validator passes (non-strict mode).
Priya K: For guardrails section, suggest an example JSON Schema showing `additionalProperties: true` at top-level envelope but `additionalProperties: false` inside `payload` where strictness matters.
Sam W: Done in commit. Also added a small bash health-check users can run pre-upgrade: 
```bash
# find legacy function-calling usages
rg "function-calling|invoke_function" -n docs/ || echo "no legacy uses found"
```
link-checker: retrying link-check...
link-checker: link-check passed
Sam W: CI is green on deploy-preview now: https://deploy.preview/358 :white_check_mark:
Jules R: Reviewed and approved the Node snippet tweak. Left a tiny README note about env_version semantics.
Priya K: I'll add a short blurb in Optimize docs recommending auto-retry on `partial` with an alternate model and a cost/latency tradeoff note.
Sam W: Ready to squash and merge after one more quick docs spellcheck pass. Thanks everyone.
